messages.author: Kaleem Arshad
messages.body:
Hi, all, hope you are doing well.
I am trying to install cuda toolkit for cuda version of AMBER apps. There are a lot of instructions to download and install it. I have GTX 1060 installed on windows with latest driver. Now what steps should I take? Please explain a little in detail. Thanking you in advance for your help.
Kaleem Arshad

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Tue, Feb 20, 2024, Kaleem Arshad via AMBER wrote:
>I am trying to install cuda toolkit for cuda version of AMBER apps. There
>are a lot of instructions to download and install it. I have GTX 1060
>installed on windows with latest driver. Now what steps should I
>take? Please explain a little in detail. Thanking you in advance for your
>help.
Please see
https://ambermd.org/InstWindows.php
. Windows support in Amber is
almost exclusively using WSL2. I haven't personally heard much, one way or
the other, about how all this might work with CUDA. Maybe others on the
list have some experience to share.
....dac
